title: Harvard Observatory computers
alt: An old photograph of a long room lined with bookshelves, its desks piled with papers and ledgers; nine women in long dresses pose among the desks.
author: Harvard University Archives
description: Harvard Computers and Mary Anna Palmer Draper are pictured together. It was taken in the long computing room on the south side of the second floor of the building in 1891, facing east. Left to right: unknown woman (standing), unknown woman (seated), possibly Evelyn Leland, Mrs. Draper (seated), Antonia Maury, Williamina Fleming, possibly Mabel C. Stevens (or some other Stevens), probably Florence Cushman, unknown woman. This description is based on http://hea-www.harvard.edu/~fine/Observatory/eleland.html#ComputersDraperPose Photo credit: HUV 1210 (9-3), olvwork289691. Harvard University Archi
